subject: zoology

verification.note: Sourced from the Sri Chaitanya Junior Fastrack zoology section (book p.46, SAQ 53). Zoology holds only ONE source book — the TSBIE Basic Learning Material in hand covers physics only, and no zoology board paper is in the corpus — so the two-book union check and the back-test are both structurally impossible for this card; 'not checked' does NOT mean 'checked and clean'. The mark split is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it.

steps.label: Definition
lines: The greenhouse effect is a naturally
occurring phenomenon that is responsible for
the heating of the earth's surface and its
atmosphere.
It is named after a glass greenhouse, which
lets sunlight in and holds the heat inside.
steps.why: The word naturally is placed first because the greenhouse effect is not itself a pollution problem; only the increase in the gases is, and a student who calls the effect harmful has answered the global warming question instead.
common_mistakes: Writing that the greenhouse effect is caused by pollution. The effect itself is natural.
Confusing it with global warming. Global warming is the RISE in the effect above normal.
steps.memory_tip: The atmosphere works like the glass of a greenhouse: light passes in, heat does not pass out.
steps.margin_note: One sentence with the word naturally in it. Do not start on global warming here.

steps.label: Radiation reaching the earth
lines: When sunlight reaches the outermost layer of
the atmosphere, some radiation is absorbed
there.
About one fourth of the solar radiation is
reflected back by the clouds and gases.
Only about half of the incoming solar
radiation reaches the earth's surface, and
the earth gets heated.
steps.why: The three fractions are the physical account of the effect, and giving them in order — absorbed, reflected, reaching the ground — shows the examiner the answer is describing a process and not just naming it.
common_mistakes: Writing that all the sunlight reaches the ground. Only about half of it does.
Swapping the fractions. About one fourth is reflected; about half reaches the surface.
steps.memory_tip: Some absorbed, one fourth reflected, one half arrives — that is the sunlight's journey down.
steps.margin_note: Three short statements with the fractions attached. Keep them in order.

steps.label: Role of the greenhouse gases
lines: The heated earth sends a part of this heat
back into the atmosphere.
The greenhouse gases, mainly carbon dioxide
(CO₂) and methane (CH₄), absorb this heat.
They reflect a major part of it back to the
earth's surface instead of letting it
escape into space.
steps.why: This step is the mechanism and therefore the heart of the answer: the gases act on the heat going UP, not on the sunlight coming down, and that direction is what the mark is for.
common_mistakes: Writing that the greenhouse gases stop the sunlight. They act on the HEAT leaving the earth.
Naming only carbon dioxide. Methane is the second named greenhouse gas here.
steps.memory_tip: Light goes in easily, heat cannot get out. The gases work on the way UP, not the way down.
steps.margin_note: Name the two gases and say clearly that they send the heat back DOWN.

steps.label: Result

lines.text: Heat is trapped, so the earth warms up

lines: Because of this, the earth's surface heats up
once again.
This whole phenomenon is called the
greenhouse effect.
Without it the earth would be far too cold
for living things.
steps.why: Closing with the name of the phenomenon completes the answer as the question asked it, and the last line makes clear why the effect is described as natural and useful.
common_mistakes: Ending with the harmful effects. Those belong to the global warming question.
Not naming the phenomenon at the end. The examiner looks for the closing sentence.
steps.memory_tip: Natural and useful at the normal level; harmful only when the gases increase.
steps.margin_note: Close by naming the phenomenon. One line on why it is needed.

insider_note: Keep this answer separate from global warming: the greenhouse effect is the natural process, and global warming is what happens when the gases rise above their normal level.
